name: zeux/meshoptimizer
description: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render by optimizing vertex cache, overdraw, and vertex fetch, with built-in geometry compression. Includes gltfpack CLI for full glTF pipeline optimization.
score_rationale: Widely adopted, high-quality mesh compression and optimization library with 7.4k stars, MIT licensed, and actively maintained — essential for production asset pipelines.
summary: Mesh compression and optimization for faster rendering with vertex cache tuning
